title: The restricted model projection satisfies the overlap equation
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $D$ a transport descent datum on $V\to X$ [def-pd-descent-datum]. For every affine open $A$ of $S$, put $X_A=X\times_S A$ and $V_A=V\times_X X_A$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and give $V_A\to X_A$ a datum $E_A$ relative to $X_A\to A$ whose transports project to D-transports on V. Let $W_A\to A$ and $r_A:V_A\to W_A$ form a Cartesian square with $V_A\to X_A$ and $X_A\to A$, and assume $r_A$ is invariant under $E_A$. For any affine inclusion $i:U\hookrightarrow B$, write $c_i:V_U\to V_B$ for restriction. For any scheme $T$ and maps $g,h:T\to V_U$ with $g r_U=h r_U$, one has $g c_i r_B=h c_i r_B$. The covering hypothesis on f is unnecessary for this overlap equation.

proof.text: Write a and b for the images of g and h in X_U. Their images in U agree by the Cartesian square. Transport the point g along E_U from a to b. Invariance and the universal property of the U-model square identify this point with h.

The restriction maps j : X_U -> X_B and c : V_U -> V_B preserve projection to X and V. Compare E_U-transport followed by c with E_B-transport of g followed by c. Their projections to V agree by the two hcompat equations. Projection V_B -> V is mono since it is a base change of the open immersion B -> S, hence the transported points agree. Invariance of r_B gives the desired equation. The Lean private transport_left_congr proves the equality of dependent transport expressions by substituting their equal endpoints and equal underlying point maps.

theorem fpqc_affine_model_transition_reconstruction
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    {V : Over X} (D : Over.DescentDatum f V)
    (E : ∀ U : S.affineOpens,
      Over.DescentDatum (pullback.snd f U.1.ι)
        (Over.mk (pullback.snd V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι))))
    (hcompat : ∀ U : S.affineOpens,
        ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (a b : T ⟶ pullback f U.1.ι)
          (hab : a ≫ pullback.snd f U.1.ι = b ≫ pullback.snd f U.1.ι)
          (x : Over.mk a ⟶ Over.mk (pullback.snd V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι))),
          (D.transport (a ≫ pullback.fst f U.1.ι) (b ≫ pullback.fst f U.1.ι)
            (by simp only [Category.assoc, pullback.condition]; rw [← Category.assoc,
              ← Category.assoc, hab])
            (Over.homMk (x.left ≫ pullback.fst V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι))
              (by simpa [Category.assoc, pullback.condition] using
                  congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ pullback.fst f U.1.ι) (Over.w x)))).left =
            ((E U).transport a b hab x).left ≫ pullback.fst V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι))
    (W : ∀ U : S.affineOpens, Over U.1.toScheme)
    (r : ∀ U : S.affineOpens,
      pullback V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι) ⟶ (W U).left)
    (hp : ∀ U, IsPullback (r U) (pullback.snd V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι))
      (W U).hom (pullback.snd f U.1.ι))
    (hinv : ∀ (U : S.affineOpens) {T : Scheme.{u}}
      (a b : T ⟶ pullback f U.1.ι)
      (hab : a ≫ pullback.snd f U.1.ι = b ≫ pullback.snd f U.1.ι)
      (x : Over.mk a ⟶ Over.mk (pullback.snd V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι))),
      ((E U).transport a b hab x).left ≫ r U = x.left ≫ r U)
    {U B : S.affineOpens} (i : U ⟶ B)
    {T : Scheme.{u}}
    (g h : T ⟶ pullback V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι))
    (hgh : g ≫ r U = h ≫ r U) :
    g ≫ Scheme.Cover.trans ((S.directedAffineCover.pullback₁ f).pullback₁ V.hom) i ≫ r B =
      h ≫ Scheme.Cover.trans ((S.directedAffineCover.pullback₁ f).pullback₁ V.hom) i ≫ r B
